from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive log probabilities")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a Boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_weights = raw_weights.sum()
    if sum_weights <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Future horizon must be positive")
    norm_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights

    # Weighted average log probabilities
    weighted_avg_with = logp_with_result @ norm_weights   # (n_candidates,)
    weighted_avg_no_call = logp_no_call @ norm_weights

    # Compute margin and keep mask
    margin = weighted_avg_with - weighted_avg_no_call
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin"}

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive log probabilities")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a Boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_weights = raw_weights.sum()
    if sum_weights <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Future horizon must be positive")
    norm_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights

    # Weighted average log probabilities
    weighted_avg_with = logp_with_result @ norm_weights   # (n_candidates,)
    weighted_avg_no_call = logp_no_call @ norm_weights

    # Compute margin and keep mask
    margin = weighted_avg_with - weighted_avg_no_call
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
